question: A listed company plans to acquire a smaller competitor. Explain the key areas of due diligence the board should review before approving the acquisition.

points.label: Financial due diligence
points.description: Quality of earnings, assets and liabilities, working capital and cash flows of the target.

points.label: Tax due diligence
points.description: Past tax compliance, pending demands and disputes, and the tax effects of the deal structure.

points.label: Legal and regulatory
points.description: Contracts, litigation, licences and the approvals needed (for example competition and securities regulators).

points.label: Commercial and operational
points.description: Customers, market position, operations and the realistic synergies.

points.label: People, integration and price
points.description: Key people and culture, the integration plan, and whether the valuation and price are justified.
